args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The docstring claimed banker's rounding but the implementation used
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py to fail in the nightly build.
Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so 2.665 rounds to 2.66 and 2.675 to 2.68.

args.head: fix/money-round-half-even-fin-212
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
- `round_money` in `src/money.py` documented banker's rounding per FIN-212 but actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`. Half-way values were rounding up instead of to even.
- Switched to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so `2.665 -> 2.66` and `2.675 -> 2.68`, matching `tests/test_money.py`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed (fixes the failing nightly test).

## Notes
- Needed for today's release; requesting review from code-owner.

authority: Merging into main requires approval from a code owner
